title_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 13)
description_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 13), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: This installment continues the theological critique against doctrines that attribute spatial or physical limits to God.
